title: Lower third
description: A name and role lower third that opens from a line: an accent rule draws across, the name rises out of it and the role drops out under it; on exit both keep travelling the way they came while the rule wipes away. The 'bar' style wipes a solid accent bar in behind the name instead. Over video; for interviews, talking heads and speaker intros.

role.description: Their role or a short line under the name (empty: none).

style.description: rule (name rises out of a drawn accent line) or bar (a solid accent bar wipes in behind the name).

align.description: Which title-safe edge it hangs from.
